display_name: LoRa W24 扩展源域强扰动训练（Full）
description: Isolate the effect of extending source pre-resampling severe additive noise support beyond the usual generic simulator.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI archived W24 and immutable release; local CPU independent truth-last collector.
code.cwd: Released archived W24 implementation directory; LoRa experiment files resolved from immutable new release.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Fixed original E104, matched lawful source L_s true CE and clean U_s high-confidence pseudo CE, source-only independent generic perturbations. No input from U_s true TX, target, source V, registered practical, or any true simulation trace during fitting.

checkpoint.initialization: Both arms strictly restore G from the same pre-target source-selected fixed-E104 clean-PL step 6000 (after source U-Net step 24000). Reset AdamW. E104 stays immutable.

sources.role: Frozen first recovery and formal Full historical comparator.
Original E104 PAMF and fixed clean anchor; remains fixed in G-only CE row.
Fixed-step original loss U-Net common initialization.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Exact current LoRa source packet roles and fixed source selection of parent before target. Neither candidate fit consumes target IQ or target scores.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze both at +10000. Only strong_source may promote; 300 same Full source packets. Six correct strictly higher than the matched arm and all other frozen references. Low urban strictly higher than the matched arm and at least the other references. Clean at least direct and frozen parent.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 preferred 7,0,3,2,6,5, >=12 GiB available and fewer than eight existing contexts. Two fitting workers and up to three formal workers, one worker per physical GPU.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent steps on failed real source smoke, unexpected fixed reader updates, source contract mismatch, nonfinite fit or missing paired predictions. No formal if preregistered source conditions fail. Preserve outputs and other processes.

metric_names: sampled waveform and clean training losses
strong source branch actual sampled exposures and nominal SNR range
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source score then conditional local w24_joint_pamf collect after all Full shards are frozen.

rows.method: Matched fixed-E104 recovery continued with original generic disturbances
rows.seed_notes: Shared 2026112997 data sampler and original generic impairment RNG; separate 2026112998 generator for source low-SNR replacements. Existing paired source V panel seed 2026112559.
rows.optimizer: AdamW weight decay 1e-4, G lr 4e-5 cosine to 2e-6, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 10000 additional AdamW steps, 160000 L_s and 160000 U_s exposures; 40000 cumulative G steps including two previous training stages.

rows.method: Matched fixed-E104 recovery continued with original generic draws and a one-third low SNR replacement
rows.seed_notes: Shared 2026112997 data sampler and original generic impairment RNG; separate 2026112998 generator for source low-SNR replacements. Existing paired source V panel seed 2026112559.
rows.optimizer: AdamW weight decay 1e-4, G lr 4e-5 cosine to 2e-6, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 10000 additional AdamW steps, 160000 L_s and 160000 U_s exposures; 40000 cumulative G steps including two previous training stages.

notes: Both arms consume identical L_s/U_s packet orders and original generic augmentation draws, and use original unchanged losses and half readout. Only the experimental arm applies separately seeded Bernoulli replacements before the native resampler. Nominal SNR is uniform from -8 to +4 dB, measured against the legal source ground-receiver IQ energy at capture rate. Circular complex Gaussian noise is scaled to exact per-packet RMS. No pose, RX, scene, target or true impairments are reused.
Confidence threshold 0.95 reads frozen E104 on clean source U_s only. The actual accepted count and replaced count are disclosed.

Same 300-packet source V Full matrix, fixed earlier source parent and matched control. Prior target artifacts are historical comparison only. Official Full source-qualified candidate uses original E104 and the full frozen target matrix with independent truth-last.
